articles.title: Apparent GTA 6 Footage And Map Leak As Rockstar Issues Takedowns
articles.summary: New footage and details about Rockstar Games' Grand Theft Auto 6 appear to have been leaked online. While the full veracity of the intel has yet to be confirmed, Rockstar's DMCA takedown requests suggest that some of it could be legitimate..
body: Those demands have been shared on social media with a further warning that, "These commandments are the floor--not the ceiling--of what is acceptable." The statement also threatens to target publishers for additional leaks if the commandment are violated.

The first game footage clip--which is already becoming scarce online--features GTA 6 co-lead Jason hanging out at home and playing a little basketball. It also features a look at the game's modified HUD and a basketball tutorial that goes over the minigame's controls. The clip is only about a minute long, and some viewers have suggested that it's from a much earlier build of the game than the one heading to stores in a few months.

In the second video from the leaker, Jason is behind the wheel of a car as the game shows off its driving gameplay. After crashing into several vehicles, Jason angers a delivery driver who challenges him to a fight. The subsequent encounter utilizes the game's combat engine. And the aftermath of the fight attracts some unwanted attention from the cops.
A map of GTA 6's Leonida setting was also part of the leak, but it's unclear if it came from Rockstar or if it was a fan creation.
points: New footage and details about Rockstar Games' Grand Theft Auto 6 appear to have been leaked online.
While the full veracity of the intel has yet to be confirmed, Rockstar's DMCA takedown requests suggest that some of it could be legitimate..

articles.title: Report: Tom Holland Could Earn Up to $100 Million for Spider-Man: Brand New Day Following Record-Breaking Box Office Success
articles.summary: Tom Holland stands to make a massive payday from the staggering success of his latest Spidey movie, Spider-Man: Brand New Day. As reported by The Wrap, three sources with knowledge of Holland’s contract say the A-lister secured $20 million in base pay for the Marvel blockbuster, with the added…
body: One of these sources claimed that Holland’s bonuses aren’t capped, meaning there’s no telling how much he’ll earn in total.
“He will make at least [$100 million],” they told the outlet, declining to give a ballpark amount as to what the ultimate figure could end up looking like.

The Wrap also shared a graphic showing the dramatic increase in pay Holland has commanded for his Spider-Man films over the years. In 2016, Holland earned $250,000 for his appearance in Captain America: Civil War, a number that doubled to half a million for Spider-Man: Homecoming the following year. He earned an estimated $4 million for 2019’s Far From Home and $10 million for No Way Home in 2021, making Brand New Day the most profitable picture in his Marvel career thus far.

articles.title: Surprise Xbox Game To Be Announced At Gamescom, Insider Says
articles.summary: Microsoft is gearing up to announce a new game at Gamescom this month, it appears, and it could be from an established series. Insider NateTheHate 2 said, "I've heard of a neat Xbox announcement that should be at Gamescom." He said it will be a "new game in a series" as opposed to a new IP.
body: He added that, whatever the project is, it's from a franchise that Microsoft owns, but it's not being made by a studio that Microsoft owns. That leaves open a lot of possibilities, so your guess is as good as anyone's right now as to what it may be and which studio could be behind it.

That's all we have to go on for now, but with Gamescom coming up soon, we should find out shortly. Xbox is not holding its own dedicated showcase at Gamescom, but it's possible the announcement could come during Geoff Keighley's Opening Night Live on August 25.

The Xbox booth at Gamescom will feature 25 upcoming games, including Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4, Fable, Minecraft Dungeons II, Gears of War: E-Day, Metro 2039, Stranger Than Heaven, and Alien: Isolation 2.

There will also be live broadcasts from the Xbox booth August 26 and August 27, featuring interviews, guests, gameplay reveals, trailers, "and more." Perhaps one of the interview slots will be about this upcoming mystery game.

articles.title: The Practical ASUS ZenScreen 16" 1080p Portable USB Monitor Is on Sale From Newegg via AliExpress
articles.summary: It's no surprise why USB portable monitors are becoming so popular. They provide extra screen real estate for laptop users and they're much slimmer and lighter than your average monitor so you can carry them around.
body: Newegg, via its official AliExpress storefront, is offering the ASUS ZenScreen 15.6" USB Portable Monitor (MB169CK) for just $97.86 with free shipping after $16 off coupon code " IFPT04BD ". Amazon currently sells it for $109. There are many portable monitor brands out there, but ASUS is generally considered amongst the highest quality options.

The ASUS ZenScreen is a 15.6" monitor that's designed to be portable. It weighs just 1.7 pounds and measures less than 0.5 thin. It sports a sturdy metal frame and includes a 360-degree adjustable kickstand for both portrait and landscape orientations. The 15.6" IPS display features a 1080p resolution (141ppi), 60Hz refresh rate, wide 178-degree viewing angle, and an anti-glare matte surface.

Connectivity options include two USB Type-C ports and one mini HDMI port to connect to a laptop, tablet, or handheld gaming PC for use as a main or secondary display. If your device is equipped with a USB Type-C output with Power Delivery, then a single cable can be used for both video and power. Otherwise, you'll need two cables: a mini HDMI or USB Type-C cable for video and a second USB Type-C cable to a wall charger for power.

articles.title: Star Wars: Starfighter Follows ‘Marginalized Outsiders' From the ‘Wrong Side of the Galaxy’
articles.summary: Director Shawn Levy has revealed that Star Wars: Starfighter follows characters “from the wrong side of the galaxy” in a story that drew inspiration from Francis Ford Coppola ’s 1983 film, The Outsiders. Coppola’s The Outsiders adapted S.E.
body: Coppola’s The Outsiders adapted S.E. Hinton’s classic young adult novel about clashing teens in 1960s Oklahoma. Hinton’s tale depicts the increasingly violent and tragic antagonism between the working class “Greasers” and the upper-middle-class "Socs".

Speaking with Fandango over the weekend at D23: The Ultimate Disney Fan Event, Levy said he and star Ryan Gosling sparked to that idea that the protagonists of Starfighter could, like the Greasers, come from “the wrong side of the tracks.”

“They’re not the privileged ones. They’re from the wrong side of the tracks,” Levy said. “Our characters in Starfighter are from the wrong side of the galaxy. And it’s about these sort of marginalized outsiders who find each other and have a shot at discovering heroism through their connections.”

Starfighter follows Gosling’s pilot Kade Auberon who teams up with a kid ( newcomer Flynn Gray ) on an adventure that, although only set about five years after the events of Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker, will not feature any "legacy characters" nor any “remixes” of John Williams’ iconic themes in its score.

articles.title: Don’t Boycott GTA 6, Help Win Justice Instead, Fired Devs Say
articles.summary: A group of former Grand Theft Auto 6 developers accusing Rockstar Games of union busting and currently engaged in a legal battle with the studio doesn't want players to boycott the game.
body: In a video posted by the Independent Workers' Union of Great Britain, fired members of the union made clear how they would like fans to support them in their ongoing legal dispute with Rockstar.
"We're going to make this easy for you," the former devs state. "Don't boycott GTA 6. Win justice for the people who helped make it."

As the devs go on to explain, they all worked on GTA 6 for years and poured their "hard work, skill, and creativity" into making it. Rather than boycotting their work, they want people to experience what they helped build.
"But that doesn't mean we want you to let Rockstar off the hook," the devs said.

articles.title: 5 Games With the Longest Development Time That Still Haven’t Been Released
articles.summary: Developing a competent video game is tough. Some games are such masterpieces that it's a wonder how they ever got made at all. There are so many moving parts, especially since studio sizes are often in the triple digits, that kudos needs to go to the games that are released despite going through…
body: However, some games get stuck in what is referred to in the industry as "development hell." Over the years, some of these have eventually been released, such as Duke Nukem Forever, Metroid Dread, and Skull & Bones. Others get canceled when the studio heads or publisher decides it's not worth the investment for the end product anymore. Meanwhile, some are stuck in that cycle. Here are five games that have been in development for more than 10 years and still don't have playable builds available to the public.

When you saw the headline of this article, I have little doubt that Ubisoft’s Beyond Good & Evil 2 was the first game that you thought of. These days, it's the poster child for games trapped in development hell. It started pre-production in 2007, which means that it's been in the works for a whopping 19 years. While most studios would have canceled the project by now, Ubisoft confirmed as recently as January 2026 that the game is still being worked on, as six projects were canned; Beyond Good & Evil 2 was not one of them.

articles.title: Former PlayStation boss Shuhei Yoshida told Clair Obscur devs to not call it a 'turn-based RPG' so people wouldn't 'overlook' it
articles.summary: According to former PlayStation boss Shuhei Yoshida, turn-based RPGs, particularly JRPGs, were so unpopular several years ago that he would tell indie developers to avoid using the term altogether in their marketing—even for a game like Clair Obscur: Expedition 33.
body: Yoshida recalled giving the Clair Obscur developers this advice during a lecture at the Busan Indie Connect Festival 2026 (via Automaton ). He was impressed by a demo he played a couple of years before the game was out, particularly its similarities to The Legend of Dragoon, a game he produced, but recommended the developers at Sandfall Interactive find alternative ways to describe its combat.
"It's incredibly well-made, but it would be better not to call it a turn-based RPG," he said. "That alone might cause players to overlook it."

Sandfall listened and started describing Clair Obscur's combat as "reactive turn-based battles" in its marketing. It's hard to tell if that actually had an impact on the breakout success of the game, but it probably didn't hurt.

Even if you set aside the supposed genre stigma, I think calling Clair Obscur a turn-based RPG does undercut how active the combat actually feels. It isn't the kind of game where you can get up and grab a snack in between turns. You're encouraged to study how enemies move so you can time all your dodges and parries, as if you're playing a soulslike.

articles.title: New Star Wars Series Officially Exposes a Dark Secret Behind the Sequel Trilogy
articles.summary: The annual D23 fan event in Anaheim, California, is over, but not before it delivered several exciting new Star Wars announcements, including an update on Star Wars: Starfighter. However, arguably the most exciting announcement was the reveal of the trailer and release date for Ahsoka season 2.
body: The Ahsoka season 2 trailer reveals the consequences of these events: Thrawn is back and has declared war on the Rebel Alliance. Anyone who watched Rebels or read the Thrawn novels knows that he isn’t someone to mess with, which has certain Star Wars fans scratching their heads at Thrawn’s declaration.

If the New Republic was aware of Thrawn’s intentions, how is it that they were as unprepared for Imperial factions and sympathies as they were by the time of the sequel era? And if a galactic way is about to ensue, wouldn't the characters in the subsequent sequel trilogy mention it at least once over the course of three movies. In other words: Is Dave Filoni’s live-action sequel to Rebels unintentionally breaking Star Wars canon?
Not quite, but the reason why reveals an even bigger conspiracy in the Star Wars saga.

articles.title: HBO’s Sci-Fi Detective Series With a Near-Perfect Rotten Tomatoes Score Is Officially #1 on Streaming
articles.summary: HBO has a little something for everyone. From grounded dramas like The White Lotus to comedies like The Chair Company, the network has a varied library of shows worth a binge. In 2026, HBO's lineup has been dominated by genre hits, specifically science-fiction and fantasy.
body: In between all those releases is Lanterns, the latest DC Universe project that just premiered on Sunday. As of this writing, it has a 94% on Rotten Tomatoes as critics are in agreement that it's one of the best TV shows around. Audiences are enjoying it too, as it has an 86% on Rotten Tomatoes' viewer-voted Popcornmeter. Those viewers have made it the number one show on HBO Max. This has propelled Lanterns to the #1 spot on HBO Max in the U.S. and #3 on the streamer worldwide, according to third-party tracker FlixPatrol.
Ther'es no denying Lanterns is a hit, but should you check it out?

Lanterns follows Green-Lantern-in-training John Stewart (Aaron Pierre) and his mentor Hal Jordan (Kyle Chandler), who's a bit jaded and none-too-pleased about having to show the ropes to his eventual replacement. The pair travel to a small town in Nebraska to investigate a mass shooting, which Jordan is convinced involved aliens. Knowing a thing or two about aliens as a space cop, his hunch is eventually proven right. Throughout the episode, he and Stewart investigate the mysteries of this small town and its people, which likely include even more aliens in disguise.

body: It's an evocative backdrop to The Sinking City 2's retooled action, beginning with a trip to Miskatonic University and the search for an ancient rite that might wake Rafferty's lover from her endless slumber. And while the sequel's boaty business initially suggests a return of its predecessor's semi-open-world tootling, it's all a bit of a ruse, and it quickly turns into a leaner, more focused kind of adventure. Early on, momentum is halting as Rafferty traverses Arkham's accursed floodwaters; charting a linear path until he reaches the next impasse, at which point the shift to survival horror, with all its familiar trappings, is immediate.

articles.title: How to get Chromite in Palworld
articles.summary: Chromite isn't actually rare in Palworld, but you've got to have a specific tool (or pal) to mine it, which is different from most other resources. To save you from the guesswork, I'll show you how to use a metal detector to get Chromite initially and also a passive farming solution for bigger…
body: Chromite is found underground on Feybreak Island, just south of Mount Obsidian, but you'll need to craft a Metal Detector or catch a Smokie to assist in digging it up. Using Smokie's partner skill is the easiest way to farm early on, but I'd recommend crafting a Metal Detector if you have the spare materials. It's expensive to make, but it's much faster and won't take up a pal slot.

The Metal Detector is easy to use and automatically scans the soil around you as you explore. If you use Smokie's partner skill you've got to spam it by pressing the E key while you walk around instead. When either method detects Chromite, a rocky node (highlighted by a blue beacon) sprouts from the ground. Harvest it with a pickaxe, just like you would any other ore.

It's a grim process, but hey, it works. The remains of every Smokie you put in the conveyor should drop Chromite, so long as you don't mind the wait for eggs it's an easy, passive alternative to hunting down nodes around the map.
